confidence_notes: Restaurant, beer and coffee anchors rest on aggregator averages and Turkish city data of uncertain date; Turkish inflation is above 30%, so these may already be stale. Wine and cocktail are not directly sourced: they use a beer-ratio basis (cocktail about 2.2x draught beer, wine glass about 1.2x). Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not based on any search or live listings. The FX observation came from a search-result summary of the RBA table, not from an opened RBA page, so verify it against the official table before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Marmaris is on the Turkish Aegean coast in Anatolia, so it is placed in Middle East for region. Food and drink are benchmarked on Marmaris-specific aggregator averages (Citycost, Almurakib, Whereandwhen, Numbeo via Traveloffpath), cross-checked against Istanbul and Izmir pub, cafe and restaurant figures converted at roughly 46.5 TRY per USD. Resort seafront pricing is assumed to sit above those averages. Accommodation is estimated from general knowledge of Turkish Aegean resort-town pricing in peak July season.
